function.name: schedule_event
function.description: Schedule a future event or routine. Actions run in order. Use voice_notification only for a reminder that the user must acknowledge; use set_light for a future light change. Provide offset_minutes OR date and time, never both.

offset_minutes.description: Whole number of minutes from now.

date.description: Future date: YYYY-MM-DD. Requires time parameter.

time.description: Future time: h:mm AM or h:mm PM. Requires date parameter.

actions.description: Non-empty array of actions in execution order. Each action has type: voice_notification or set_light. voice_notification needs text. set_light needs room and power. confirmation_message is spoken after a successful set_light, and should be used if the user asks for confirmation.

text.description: Required for voice_notification: exact words to say.

confirmation_message.description: Optional spoken confirmation for set_light. Include only if requested.

function.name: list_scheduled_events
function.description: List upcoming scheduled events. Use before cancelling when the event ID is unknown.

function.name: cancel_scheduled_event
function.description: Cancel an upcoming event by its exact event_id.

event_id.description: Exact ID from schedule_event or list_scheduled_events.

function.name: acknowledge_notification
function.description: Acknowledge an active notification only after the user clearly completes, dismisses, or cancels it.

function.name: get_current_datetime
function.description: Get the current date, time, and day of week. Use this for questions about the current time, date, day, month, or year.

function.name: get_light_status
function.description: Get the current on or off state of one room's lights.

function.name: set_light
function.description: Immediately turn one room's lights on or off. For a future light action, use schedule_event.
